thread:
maria: Heads up — legal asked for an immediate hold on deletions for cust AcmeCo while they investigate a compliance request. Need a quick checklist: what we can export now, what needs a KMS freeze, and estimated timelines.

support-lucas: Acknowledged. Do we have a retention override already on the account?

maria: Not that I can find in the UI. Customer says they had a custom TTL but account page shows default retention.

sre-eli: If there's no override, deletions will follow default TTL. We can place a retention hold (prevent deletes) but that requires KMS export + snapshot for the private deployment. For hosted, we can flag the tenant and block the delete API.

legal-jordan: Need confirmation we can produce audit logs for the window 2025-12-01 → 2026-03-01, and a tamper-evident export. Also, what are the earliest and latest realistic times to complete the export?

devon: Gathering audit logs is usually quick — can stream JSON of admin/audit events. For a full tamper-evident export we sign the bundle and store the hash in our HSM. That process typically takes 24–48h depending on queue.

support-lucas: Quick repro steps to grab logs: 
```
# admin export
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/audit?tenant=acmeco&start=2025-12-01&end=2026-03-01" \
  -o acmeco-audit.ndjson
```

sre-eli: Note: if any objects were already purged per TTL, audit will still show delete events but payloads won't be recoverable. We should check for delete events in the range before assuming data exists to export.

maria: Customer is insisting no deletes until legal signs off. Can we place an immediate soft-hold that prevents further API-initiated deletes but doesn't break live reads?

devon: Yes — we can flip a tenant-level flag: retention_hold=true. It intercepts delete API calls and returns 423 Locked. I can schedule the change now. Impact: no reads blocked. Backfill/restore still possible through support workflow.

support-lucas: What about KMS? If the hold is soft at app-level, keys remain rotating. Legal wants HSM-backed non-repudiation. What's needed to create a signed export?

sre-eli: For signed export we need to: (1) freeze key rotation in KMS for the relevant tenant key or create an export key, (2) run export job to S3 with server-side encryption using that key, (3) sign the archive using HSM-stored signing key and emit a SHA256sum + signature. Steps 1–3 take ~24–72h operationally.

legal-jordan: Please provide an exact checklist and a timeline estimate we can share with the customer's counsel. Also we need the export delivered to their SFTP.

maria: Lucas, can you confirm whether AcmeCo is on hosted or dedicated? That affects KMS access.

support-lucas: They are on hosted multi-tenant with customer-managed keys (CMK) in our KMS integration. So we don't have HSM on-prem, but we can sign the archive with our HSM signing key and include the CMK-wrapped envelope.

devon: Action items I can take now: 1) flip retention_hold flag (immediate) 2) queue audit export job and capture delete events 3) request key freeze window from KMS team. Need approval from SRE for step 3.

sre-eli: Approved for key freeze window. I'll coordinate with KMS team. Please open a ticket with details: tenant id, time window, delivery SFTP host, point of contact.

maria: I'll draft the ticket now and ping legal for language. Lucas — can you start the retention_hold change and post the result here?

support-lucas: On it. Applying retention_hold=true... 

ops-bot: retention_hold applied to tenant acmeco by support-lucas at 1845007002 :white_check_mark:

support-lucas: Verified — delete API now returns 423. Also kicked off audit export job; job id export-2026-04-acmeco-11 queued.

maria: Thanks. SRE/devon/legal, I'll share timeline draft in the ticket and mark this thread for emergency follow-up.

legal-jordan: Received. Once we have the signed export + hash and SFTP confirmation I'll sign the hold release instructions.

devon: ETA for signed export: 36–48h assuming no backlog. Will update job status in ticket.

maria: Great — let's keep updates concise here. If anything blocks, tag @sre-eli. :thumbsup:
